reason: A proposes a physically plausible, direct interfacial intervention: Ti is a reactive wetting/bonding layer for otherwise poorly compatible W–Cu, and its controlled comparison can test void suppression and thermal-conductivity retention. B relies on weakly justified graphene-mediated wetting and diffusion claims, while its precise 20–25% improvement and multiple asserted effects lack supporting evidence and may conflict with graphene agglomeration and added thermal-boundary resistance.
